description: Source code for the MotionDetection plugin, implementing motion detection control and event handling within the WPEFramework platform.

classes.name: WPEFramework::Plugin::MotionDetection
classes.description: Main class implementing motion detection plugin, handling initialization, control commands, and motion events.

methods.name: MotionDetection::getMotionDetectors
methods.description: Retrieves list and info of available motion detectors.

methods.name: MotionDetection::arm
methods.description: Arms a specified motion detector with a given mode.

methods.name: MotionDetection::isarmed
methods.description: Checks if a specified motion detector is armed.

methods.name: MotionDetection::setNoMotionPeriod
methods.description: Sets the no-motion period for a detector.

methods.name: MotionDetection::getNoMotionPeriod
methods.description: Gets the current no-motion period for a detector.

methods.name: MotionDetection::setSensitivity
methods.description: Sets the sensitivity for a detector.

methods.name: MotionDetection::getSensitivity
methods.description: Retrieves the current sensitivity setting of a detector.

methods.name: MotionDetection::getLastMotionEventElapsedTime
methods.description: Returns the elapsed time since the last motion event.

methods.name: MotionDetection::setMotionEventsActivePeriod
methods.description: Sets active periods for motion events.

methods.name: MotionDetection::getMotionEventsActivePeriod
methods.description: Retrieves active periods for motion events.

methods.name: MotionDetection::onMotionEvent
methods.description: Handles motion detection events and notifies observers.
